", "orange": "data:image/webp;base64,", "pin": "data:image/webp;base64,", "queen": "data:image/webp;base64,"};
const WORDS=['ink','jug','kangaroo','lamp','mouse','nest','orange','pin','queen'];
function fit(){const b=document.getElementById('board');const s=Math.min(innerWidth/1536,innerHeight/1024);b.style.transform=`scale(${s})`;b.style.left=((innerWidth-1536*s)/2)+'px';b.style.top=((innerHeight-1024*s)/2)+'px'}addEventListener('resize',fit);fit();
function speak(t){if(!speechSynthesis)return;speechSynthesis.cancel();let u=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(t);u.lang='en-US';u.rate=.82;speechSynthesis.speak(u)}
let tt;function toast(t,good=true){let e=document.getElementById('toast');e.textContent=t;e.style.background=good?'rgba(54,156,83,.94)':'rgba(205,74,90,.94)';e.classList.add('show');clearTimeout(tt);tt=setTimeout(()=>e.classList.remove('show'),1200)}
function setStatus(id,t,good=true){let e=document.getElementById(id);e.textContent=t;e.className='status '+(good?'ok':'bad')}

// task1
const wordOrder=['ink','jug','kangaroo','lamp','mouse','nest','orange','pin','queen'];
const picOrder=['queen','orange','nest','kangaroo','ink','mouse','pin','jug','lamp'];
let selectedWord=null,matched=new Set();
function renderMatch(){let wg=document.getElementById('wordGrid'),pg=document.getElementById('picGrid');wg.innerHTML='';pg.innerHTML='';wordOrder.forEach(w=>{let b=document.createElement('button');b.className='wordTile';b.dataset.word=w;b.textContent=w;b.onclick=()=>selectW(b,w);wg.appendChild(b)});picOrder.forEach(w=>{let b=document.createElement('button');b.className='picTile';b.dataset.word=w;b.innerHTML=`<img src="${IMG[w]}" alt="${w}">`;b.onclick=()=>selectP(b,w);pg.appendChild(b)})}
function selectW(b,w){if(matched.has(w))return;document.querySelectorAll('.wordTile').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('sel'));b.classList.add('sel');selectedWord=w}
function selectP(b,w){if(!selectedWord||matched.has(w))return;let wb=document.querySelector(`.wordTile[data-word="${selectedWord}"]`);if(selectedWord===w){matched.add(w);wb.classList.remove('sel');wb.classList.add('done');b.classList.add('done');drawLine(wb,b);speak(w);selectedWord=null;setStatus('s1',matched.size===9?'Все пары найдены!':'Правильно!');}else{wb.classList.remove('sel');selectedWord=null;toast('Попробуй ещё раз',false)}}
function drawLine(a,b){let svg=document.getElementById('matchSvg'),ar=a.getBoundingClientRect(),br=b.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=svg.getBoundingClientRect(),sx=1536/parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.getElementById('board')).width); // unused
 let x1=(ar.right-sr.left)/(sr.width)*svg.clientWidth,y1=(ar.top+ar.height/2-sr.top)/(sr.height)*svg.clientHeight,x2=(br.left-sr.left)/(sr.width)*svg.clientWidth,y2=(br.top+br.height/2-sr.top)/(sr.height)*svg.clientHeight;let p=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','path');let mx=(x1+x2)/2;p.setAttribute('d',`M${x1},${y1} C${mx},${y1} ${mx},${y2} ${x2},${y2}`);p.setAttribute('fill','none');p.setAttribute('stroke','#6d9fca');p.setAttribute('stroke-width','2.4');p.setAttribute('stroke-linecap','round');svg.appendChild(p)}

// task2
const missing=[['jug','_ug',['j']],['lamp','l_mp',['a']],['mouse','m__se',['o','u']],['nest','n_st',['e']],['orange','_range',['o']],['queen','q_e_n',['u','e']]];
function renderMissing(){let box=document.getElementById('missingGrid');box.innerHTML='';missing.forEach((r,i)=>{let [w,pat,ans]=r,d=document.createElement('div');d.className='mcard';let html='',ai=0;for(let ch of pat){if(ch==='_'){html+=`<input class="letterInput" maxlength="1" data-answer="${ans[ai++]}">`}else html+=ch}d.innerHTML=`<div class="mnum">${i+1}</div><img src="${IMG[w]}"><div class="mword">${html}</div>`;box.appendChild(d)});box.querySelectorAll('input').forEach(inp=>inp.addEventListener('input',()=>{inp.value=inp.value.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]/g,'').slice(0,1);inp.classList.remove('correct','wrong');if(inp.value){if(inp.value===inp.dataset.answer)inp.classList.add('correct');else inp.classList.add('wrong')}let all=[...box.querySelectorAll('input')].every(x=>x.value===x.dataset.answer);if(all)setStatus('s2','Все буквы на месте!')}))}

// task3
const scr=[['pin',['p','n','i']],['ink',['i','k','n']],['jug',['g','u','j']],['nest',['t','s','n','e']]];
function renderScr(){let box=document.getElementById('scrambleGrid');box.innerHTML='';scr.forEach(([w,letters],i)=>{let d=document.createElement('div');d.className='scard';d.dataset.word=w;d.innerHTML=`<img src="${IMG[w]}"><div class="schips"></div><div class="build"></div><button class="clear">очистить</button>`;let c=d.querySelector('.schips');letters.forEach((l,j)=>{let b=document.createElement('button');b.className='chip';b.textContent=l;b.dataset.l=l;b.onclick=()=>{if(d.classList.contains('good'))return;b.classList.add('used');d.querySelector('.build').textContent+=l;checkScr(d)};c.appendChild(b)});;d.querySelector('.clear').onclick=()=>clearScr(d);box.appendChild(d)})}
function clearScr(d){d.classList.remove('good');d.querySelector('.build').textContent='';d.querySelectorAll('.chip').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('used'))}
function checkScr(d){let s=d.querySelector('.build').textContent,w=d.dataset.word;if(s.length===w.length){if(s===w){d.classList.add('good');speak(w);if(document.querySelectorAll('.scard.good').length===4)setStatus('s3','Все слова собраны!')}else{toast('Буквы пока не в том порядке',false);setTimeout(()=>clearScr(d),500)}}}

// task4
const tf=[['mouse','This is a cat',false],['orange','This is an orange',true],['lamp','This is a jug',false],['queen','This is a queen',true],['nest','This is a pin',false],['ink','This is ink',true]];
function renderTF(){let box=document.getElementById('tfList');box.innerHTML='';tf.forEach(([w,t,ans],i)=>{let r=document.createElement('div');r.className='tfrow';r.dataset.ans=ans;r.innerHTML=`<div class="tfnum">${i+1}.</div><img src="${IMG[w]}"><div class="tftext">${t}</div><button class="yn" data-v="true">✓</button><button class="yn" data-v="false">✕</button>`;r.querySelectorAll('.yn').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{if(r.dataset.done)return;let v=b.dataset.v==='true';if(v===ans){r.dataset.done='1';b.classList.add(v?'selectedTrue':'selectedFalse');speak(w);if(box.querySelectorAll('[data-done="1"]').length===6)setStatus('s4','Все ответы верны!')}else{b.classList.add('selectedFalse');toast('Проверь ещё раз',false);setTimeout(()=>b.classList.remove('selectedFalse'),400)}});box.appendChild(r)})}
